name: AMERICAN AUTOMOTIVE LLC
old_description: Our quality flooring products have been the industry go-to since 2017 for outstanding and long-lasting performance. Offering five different systems, we bring a variety of durable concrete, versatile epoxies, and coats to repair and protect against all elements.
about:
American Automotive LLC operates as a Rhino Linings applicator in Livingston, Montana. The location at 320 1/2 North Main Street provides professionally installed spray-on protective coatings for vehicles and equipment. While the Rhino Linings brand was established in 1988, the founding date of this independently owned applicator is not publicly disclosed.

The shop applies Rhino Linings' multi-component polyurea and polyurethane formulas to truck beds, marine surfaces, trailer floors, and a range of commercial, industrial, and military equipment. The process includes deep cleaning, masking, mechanical scuffing with a multi-speed polisher, compressed-air dust removal, and spray application that develops a textured finish. Installations typically take up to three hours, with same-day vehicle return and a 24-hour cure before heavy use. The facility uses Graco and PMC proportioning equipment and stocks genuine replacement parts.

Customers include individual truck owners, fleet operators, construction companies, emergency-vehicle upfitters, marine dealers, and military maintenance units. The applicator serves the automotive, marine, commercial, industrial, and defense sectors across the region, coating everything from ATVs and RVs to heavy construction machinery and tactical vehicles.

The location differentiates itself through the Rhino Linings Nationwide Limited Lifetime Warranty on bed liners, color-matching and custom-color capabilities, and a technician-trained installation process that the company says ensures permanent adhesion and resistance to cracking, peeling, and extreme temperatures from -40 °F to 190 °F.
